title: Apparatus and Method for Packing Bulk Material into a Container

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: The apparatus ( 1 ) according to the invention for packing bulk material into a container ( 2 ) comprises a provisioning device ( 3 ) for the container ( 2 ).
features.note: The reference describes an apparatus for packing bulk material into a container, which implies some form of automated operation, but does not explicitly state an electrically operated vacuum generating device.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate

claims.note: This reference describes an apparatus for packing bulk material into a container, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device with a suction plate.
This reference describes a gripping device for containers, not a housing with a grip portion for a hand-operated laying device or an electrically operated vacuum generating device in that context.
This reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
This reference does not describe exhaust air from a vacuum generating device being guided through a hollow grip portion to an air outlet, nor a sound-damping device in the grip portion.
This reference does not disclose a sound-damping device arranged in a grip portion.
This reference does not disclose a grip portion at least partially lined with a sound-damping material.
This reference does not disclose a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion of the housing.
This reference does not disclose a sound-reducing device arranged in the first housing portion or the first housing portion being lined with sound-reducing material.
This reference does not disclose a grip unit with a grip portion elongated between a first and second housing portion, nor an air outlet arranged on the second housing portion.
This reference does not disclose an air collection device, such as an air collection screw, arranged upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion for collecting exhaust air.
This reference does not disclose bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of a grip portion in a second housing portion for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.

This reference does not disclose a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery arranged on the housing, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a coupling point.
This reference does not discuss air baffles, exhaust air, or battery coupling points.
This reference describes an apparatus for packing bulk material, not a vacuum handling apparatus.
This reference does not describe a suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to and extending around it.
This reference does not describe a grip unit as defined in claim 1 of the subject invention, which is not provided here.
This reference does not disclose a grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device.
This reference does not disclose a grip unit having a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum between a suction plate and an object.

overall.why: The reference describes an apparatus and method for packing bulk material into containers, including gripping, detecting position, and positioning the containers, which aligns with the general field of the subject invention.
